summary: Amazon confirmed Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals run 19 to 30 November, with daily themed deals; Amazon Haul's low-price event runs 9 to 14 November.
YouTube is nudging creators to turn on Shopping auto-tagging before the holiday rush, and says videos with product tags get over 110% more product clicks than description links.
LTK shared a creator who grew holiday earnings 269% by posting 572 times in 56 days.
Lasso, URLgenius and Button/Posttap were quiet; Reddit competitor searches were rate-limited (429) again.
